subject: Audit trail snapshot & export checklist for SOC 2 evidence

Cc: security@rivermarkhealth.com
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Audit trail snapshot + export requirements for SOC 2 review

Hi Camila,

We're preparing the SOC 2 readiness package and need a snapshot of admin/activity logs covering the last 90 days for evidence review. Specifically, Rivermark requires: 
- A machine-readable export (CSV preferred) of admin actions and operator events for the period 2026-10-19 to 2027-01-17.
- A manifest (file list + SHA256 checksums) and an export receipt with timestamp.
- A short statement of what fields are recorded (e.g., actor, action, resource, ip, timestamp), the retention policy currently applied, and whether any redaction is applied by default.
- Delivery options (S3 presigned, SFTP, or secure ShareLink) and expected ETA.

Deadline for receipt: 2027-01-25 COB. Please let me know if you can provide a full export or, if not, the sampling approach you recommend along with a sampling acceptance checklist.

Thanks,
Sachin
Director, Information Security
Rivermark Health

Sachin — quick operational notes from our side: 
- We usually include operator-level metadata and system-initiated actions in the same export; please confirm if you'd like those separated.
- Exports can be incremental (daily deltas) or a single full snapshot. For SOC evidence usually a full snapshot with manifest is preferred.
- If you opt for S3 presigned delivery, tell us the expected bucket prefix and expiry window. We will encrypt at rest and in transit.

Also: if the export size is large (>2GB) we may stage it as multipart objects and provide manifest pointers. Karthik, pls include a sample header row and whether we can mask last-octet of IPs for PHI concerns.

On Sun, Jan 17, 2027 at 10:05 AM Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll loop in Karthik from infra to provide schema and retention details.

Sachin — technical details below for the export; please review and flag any redaction requirements.

Logging coverage (admin/operator events):
- Fields we include (CSV header): event_time (RFC3339), tenant_id, user_id, actor_email, actor_role, action, target_resource_type, target_resource_id, request_id, ip_address, region, outcome (success/failure), latency_ms, session_id, metadata_json (stringified small JSON).
- System/internal-only columns (we can omit on request): internal_request_id, kv_cache_state, host_node_id.

Retention and default policies:
- Admin activity: default retention 365 days.
- Audit-grade snapshot retention for compliance exports: we can produce and sign an export receipt; customers may request longer retention (contract addendum).

Export formats & delivery:
- Primary: gzipped CSV files + export_manifest_YYYYMMDD.sha256 (manifest contains file names + SHA256 hex).
- Alternate: Parquet (columnar) on request for very large exports.
- Delivery: presigned S3 URL (recommended), SFTP, or encrypted ShareLink. We sign manifests with internal timestamp and include an export receipt ID.

Sampling options (if full export not desired):
- Random event sampling (by percentage),
- User-based sampling (e.g., sample 100% of admin users, 10% of service accounts),
- Time-window sampling (X days per month).

Redaction options:
- IP partial masking (mask last octet): yes, available as pre-export transformation.
- PII redaction: we can redact actor_email or hash it if requested by legal.

Example CSV header (single-line snippet):
"event_time,tenant_id,user_id,actor_email,actor_role,action,target_resource_type,target_resource_id,request_id,ip_address,outcome,latency_ms,session_id,metadata_json"

ETA: once you confirm delivery method and redaction rules, I will schedule the job. Expected time to produce full 90-day export: ~24 hours for a typical enterprise tenant; larger tenants may take up to 48 hours.

Attachments (to be produced): admin_activity_snapshot_20270117.csv (gz), export_manifest_20270117.sha256 (text).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
